prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One independent square premium near-realistic BOTANICAL textbook illustration. A small tuft of true moss growing on a damp rock, many fine leafy green shoots with simple tiny leaves, several slender reddish-brown sporophyte stalks ending in small oval spore capsules with delicate caps. Show part of the tuft lifted in a careful naturalistic cutaway revealing fine threadlike rhizoids at the base, NOT branched vascular roots. Leafy moss texture and tiny water droplets exquisitely detailed, soft three-dimensional lighting, creamy pale green background. Focus on moss as a nonvascular seedless plant example; do NOT draw flowers, fruits, seeds, pine cones, fern fronds, woody stems or internal vein bundles. No text, letters, numerals, arrows, graphs, labels, logos or watermark. No cartoon, vector or simplistic icons; a refined realistic botanical teaching plate, not claimed to be a photograph.

Use case: scientific-educational. One independent square premium near-realistic BOTANICAL textbook illustration of a fern, a seedless vascular plant. One elegant young fern growing from a short rhizome with true roots, a curled fiddlehead and finely divided fronds. One frond turns over to show its underside with realistic small rust-brown sori arranged in orderly rows on the underside of the leaflets, not on stems and not random colored beads. An unframed gentle close-up enlargement at lower side shows the lower leaflet surface with a few rounded sori made of tiny sporangia; include veins as part of the leaflet, not an invented vascular cross-section. Fine realistic green leaf texture, subtle three-dimensional lighting, warm pale cream background. Sori contain spores, not seeds; do not depict flowers, fruit, cones, seeds, pollen or insects. No words, letters, numerals, labels, arrows, graphs, logos or watermark. Refined scientific illustration, not vector or cartoon.

Use case: scientific-educational. One independent square premium near-realistic BOTANICAL textbook illustration of a pine branch with paired slender needles, an opened mature woody seed cone and a separate enlarged single cone scale bearing exactly TWO winged pine seeds on its upper surface. The two seeds have small brown seed bodies with thin translucent papery wings attached; they are not leaves or insects. The scale and seeds are exposed, not enclosed in a fruit. Arrange the natural branch and whole open cone above, the enlarged cone scale and two seeds below, with no frames and enough separation to see each structure. Rich woody cone textures, fine needles, three-dimensional light, neutral cream background, premium museum botanical plate. No flower, fruit flesh, acorns, pollen cones, extra floating seeds, text, letters, numerals, arrows, graphs, labels or watermark. Not vector, not cartoon. Seeds on an opened pine cone are the teaching focus.

Use case: scientific-educational. One independent square premium near-realistic BOTANICAL textbook illustration of a tomato plant as an example of a flowering seed plant. An elegant short branch with realistic compound leaves, a small yellow star-shaped tomato flower, one unripe green tomato and one ripe red tomato still attached. Beside the branch, a separate ripe tomato half in a clean cross section shows seeds enclosed in the moist fruit chambers, detailed translucent seed gel and thin fruit wall. This is one consistent tomato species, not a mixture of different fruits. Fine realistic botanical tissues, glossy but natural tomato skin, leaf veins, soft dimensional light, restrained warm cream background.
